main_text.p: se suorum parmásque cernere equitum. Et ferè ita Liuius. sicut & Glossæ explicant: Parma, ἀσπὶς ἱππική.

,, Assumpsere Græcanicam armaturam.] Quæ ea fuerit, nemo melius Iosepho dixerit: si tamen tam plena &Equitum omnia ar-ma, ordine. Lib. iii. Excid. instructa ea iamtunc Polybij æuo. Sed Iosephus audiatur. Τοῖς ἱππεῦσιν μάχαιρα μὲν ἐν δεξιᾷ, μάχαιρα καὶ κόντῳ ἐμ- μάχης ἐν χειρί. Θυρεὸς δὲ ... [illegible, ~20 letters] πλαγίας μὲν αἰχμάς, [illegible, ~30 letters] καὶ θώρακες, ὁμοίως τοῖς πεζοῖς, ἅπασι: Equitibus gladius est ad dextrum oblongus, & contus item longus in manu. scutum ad latus equi transuersum, & in pharetrâ portantur tria aut plura iacula, cuspide lata, & hastis magnitudine non cedentia. Galeas & loricas omnes habent, uti pedites. Fida & multiplex hæc armatura, ac lubet per partes inspicere. Ait primò gla-dium fuisse ad dextrum.Gladius in dexter. Nota igitur, more Polybiano & veteri equites tunc gestasse dextros gladios, etsi pedites eos iam haberent siniistros. Sed addit, oblongum fuisse:Isque oblongus. aliter quàm in nostris equitibus, qui breuiorem pedestri gerunt. Olim contrà, & valdè olim. Nam & in Dionysio est de equitibus Romanis, sub annum urbis CCLXVII.Lib. viii. Ἔπειτα δὲ μὲν εἰσακοντίζωσι τὰς λόγχας. ὁ δὲ ... ὁμόσε χωρίσαντας τοῖς ἱππικοῖς ξίφεσι [illegible, ~25 letters] πολλὰς ... ἠμίθανεῖς: Deinde alij eiaculati sunt lanceas, alij eos qui propius accedebant, equestribus longioribus gladiis ferientes, multos profternebant semineces. Ad duo notabilis locus. quòd & lanceas eiaculati equites sint: & quòd gladij eorum tales. page.notes: The Greek passages in the lower half of the page are printed in a blurred, small italic and could only be read in part; the unreadable spans are marked. The Greek marked [?] or partly read (ἀσπὶς ἱππική, Ἔπειτα, Παρέζωσο) should be checked against the original. The printed "CCLXVII" is a Roman numeral and is kept as printed. The left strip is the edge of the facing page and was left out. The faint marks at lower left are show-through and were left out.
